bandReport.notes:
Band b1 = Q1-Q28 across p00 (Q1-7), p01 (Q8-12), p02 (Q13-17), p03 (Q18-23), p04 (Q24-28). Layout is two-column and the per-page count VARIES (7/5/5/6/5) because option blocks and displayed fractions are set at very different heights — do not assume a fixed questions-per-page. Numbering runs down the LEFT column first, then the RIGHT (p00 left = Q1-3, right = Q4-7; p03 left = Q18-20, right = Q21-23).

SEAM (start): Q1 is the first question of the paper. p00 carries no header, no instruction preamble and no Directions block above it — it opens directly on '1. If x^2 - 20 = ...'.

SEAM (end): Q28 is COMPLETE on p04 — its stem, its two statements and all four options print there. I opened p05 (the next band's territory) WITHOUT transcribing it and confirmed the seam is CLEAN: p05 opens at Q29 (left column) and Q31 (right column), each self-contained with its own stem and its own four options. Nothing on p05 continues from p04, and nothing on p04 continues onto p05.

DIRECTIONS SETS: there are NONE anywhere in p00-p04. Every one of Q1-Q28 is a standalone MCQ, so this band opens no set and inherits none; no question carries `context` or `setLabel`. NOTE for the next band: Q27 and Q28 (and Q29/Q30 on p05, which I did not transcribe) use the 'Consider the question and two statements given below :' data-sufficiency frame. These are NOT Directions sets — each item prints its own premise, its own Question line and its own Statement-1/Statement-2, so they share no stimulus and must NOT be given a setLabel. Same call the 2022-1 bA band recorded for the identical frame.

FIGURES: none. No question in Q1-Q28 prints or refers to a diagram, so `hasFigure` is unset throughout.

DECIMALS: this band contains NO decimal numbers at all, so the raised-middle-dot rule never came into play here.

CURRENCY: none in this band.

GLYPHS VERIFIED BY TARGETED CROP AT 7-9x from the source PDF (nothing guessed): Q3 option (c) — the a and b carry NO exponents (see its flag); Q5 all four options, including the sign pattern that separates (c) from (d); Q9 both statements' exponents (a^2(b-c)^3 ...); Q10 all three denominators, whose variable ORDER differs per term — x(x-y)(x-z), y(y-z)(y-x), z(z-x)(z-y); Q11 both statements' x^4/y^4/z^4 and the inequality directions; Q12 numerator x^6 - 24x^4 + 144x^2 and denominator (x^2 + 4sqrt3 x + 12)(x - 2sqrt3)^2; Q18 all four fractions 3/5, 6/25, 9/20, 27/50; Q21 the exponents in N = 12^6 x 3^8 x 5^3; Q24 the bracketed argument 995 + sqrt(x^2 - 12x + 60); Q25 all three candidate expressions; Q26 all four options, where (a) vs (d) differ only in the first factor and (c) vs (d) only in the sign inside the squared factor; Q28 the LCM value 481.

MISPRINT FLAGGED: Q3 option (c) prints '(a + ab + b)' with no exponents where the sibling options all set theirs. Transcribed exactly as printed, not repaired.

SUBTOPICS INVENTED (2, both flagged on their questions): Q1 'Infinite Nested Radicals' and Q25 'Roots in Surd Form'. Chapters are catalog keys in both cases.

questions.stem: If \((x + k)\) is the HCF of \(x^2 + px + q\) and \(x^2 + qx + p\), where \(p \ne q\), then what is the value of k ?

If three times the greater of two numbers is divided by the smaller number, the quotient will be 6 and the remainder will be 6. If five times the smaller number is divided by the greater number, the quotient will be 2 and the remainder will be 3. What is the difference between the numbers ?

Consider the following statements :

1. \((ab + bc + ca)\) is a factor of \(a^2(b - c)^3 + b^2(c - a)^3 + c^2(a - b)^3\).

2. \((a + b + c)\) is a factor of \(a^2(b - c)^3 + b^2(c - a)^3 + c^2(a - b)^3\).

Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
What is \(\frac{1}{x(x - y)(x - z)} + \frac{1}{y(y - z)(y - x)} + \frac{1}{z(z - x)(z - y)}\) equal to ?

Consider the following statements :

1. \(x^4(y - z) + y^4(z - x) + z^4(x - y)\) is positive if \(x > y > z\).

2. \(x^4(y - z) + y^4(z - x) + z^4(x - y)\) is negative if \(x < y < z\).

Which of the above statements is/are correct ?
What is \(\frac{x^6 - 24x^4 + 144x^2}{(x^2 + 4\sqrt{3}x + 12)(x - 2\sqrt{3})^2}\) equal to ?
X and Y can do a piece of work in 45 days and 40 days respectively. They begin to work together, but X leaves after n days and then Y completes the remaining work in 23 days. What is n equal to ?

480 persons working 10 hours per day complete one-fourth of a work in 10 days. How many additional persons are to be employed in order to complete the remaining work in 20 days, working 8 hours per day ?
12 women and 16 men can do a piece of work in 5 days. 13 women and 24 men can do it in 4 days. How long will 25 women and 50 men take to do it ?

There are two stations X and Y, 1320 km apart. A train starts from station X at 6 a.m. and moves at an average speed of 60 km/hr. At 2 p.m. another train starts from Y towards X and moves at an average speed of 80 km/hr. When do they meet ?

Two glasses of equal volume are filled with a mixture of alcohol and water in the ratio 3 : 2 and 4 : 1, respectively. These glasses are emptied into a third glass. What is the ratio of alcohol and water in the third glass ?
If x is the HCF and y is the LCM of \(\frac{3}{5}, \frac{6}{25}, \frac{9}{20}, \frac{27}{50}\), then which one of the following is correct ?

There are two natural numbers x and y, where \(x > y\). When x is divided by 6, it leaves the remainder 2 and; when y is divided by 6, it leaves the remainder 3. What is the remainder when \((x - y)\) is divided by 6 ?
The value of a 2-digit number is 5 times the sum of the digits. What is the product of the digits ?

Consider the number \(N = 12^6 \times 3^8 \times 5^3\). Which of the following statements is/are correct ?

1. The number of odd factors of N is 60.

2. The number of even factors of N is 720.
